ablations.architectural_effect: Unchanged production reference using WSM v4.
Rank every hard-filtered, route-complete, commute-valid candidate with unchanged WSM v4.
ablations.interpretation: Separates shortlist quality and computational reduction from WSM ranking.

ablations.architectural_effect: Retain all routes and commute constraints but assign equal importance to each destination during access scoring.
ablations.interpretation: Tests importance weighting, not multi-destination routing itself.
confounders: profiles whose destination priorities are already equal

ablations.architectural_effect: Keep frozen routes and destination-access scoring but do not reject candidates exceeding a profile commute limit.
ablations.interpretation: Measures relevance/coverage tradeoff caused by hard commute enforcement.

ablations.architectural_effect: Remove routing-derived location from WSM and do not apply destination commute constraints; retain non-route mandatory eligibility and KNN.
ablations.weight_policy: Renormalize the original budget, space, amenities, and rent-fairness priorities to sum to one.
ablations.interpretation: Estimates the combined location-signal contribution; it is broader than importance or constraint ablations.

ablations.architectural_effect: Keep the same KNN shortlist and remove stored rent-reasonableness score from WSM.
ablations.weight_policy: Renormalize original location, budget, space, and amenities priorities to sum to one.
ablations.interpretation: Tests model-based rent reasonableness, not demographic fairness.

ablations.architectural_effect: Keep the same shortlist and remove nice-to-have amenity coverage from WSM; must-have amenities remain mandatory eligibility.
ablations.weight_policy: Renormalize original location, budget, space, and rent-fairness priorities to sum to one.
ablations.interpretation: Does not remove safety or must-have amenity filters.

ablations.component_removed: Preferred floor-size matching within Space Suitability
ablations.architectural_effect: Compute Space Suitability as the mean bedroom and bathroom components only; hard size eligibility remains intact.
ablations.weight_policy: WSM criterion weights unchanged; only the internal space component changes.
ablations.interpretation: Tests soft preferred-size matching without weakening mandatory size limits.

ablations.component_removed: Travel frequency from informational monthly travel spending
ablations.architectural_effect: Suppress frequency-derived travel and total-spend displays while leaving all production ranking inputs unchanged.
ablations.interpretation: This is an informational sensitivity/invariance check, not removal of a WSM ranking factor.
